outcome: A creature whose characteristic-defining ability sets its power or toughness shows the computed value, using 0 for any undeterminable number, including off the battlefield.
A creature with an "as enters" power/toughness choice enters with the chosen values, and shows 0/0 while not on the battlefield.
A noncreature permanent, such as an uncrewed Vehicle, has no power or toughness on the battlefield.
A power or toughness modification aimed at a noncreature permanent is created and applies once that permanent becomes a creature.
An effect that checks base power or toughness sees the value after characteristic-defining and setting effects, ignoring modifying effects and counters.
note: records show final P/T, not base

outcome: A creature with no value for power or toughness has that characteristic equal to 0.
